messages:
sam_reps: Heads-up: AtlasCare (regional hospital chain) wants a custom term for Dedicated + Private (12mo). Asking for 35% off list + onboarding SOW waived. Also requesting Net90 because of multi-dept approvals. Need deal desk + finance decision.

ivy_dealdesk: Net90 is outside playbook. What's TCV at proposed vs list and what's the expansion/strategic argument?

sam_reps: Numbers: proposed TCV = $468k (list would be $720k). Theyre a reference opportunity for our gov-hosp vertical and may roll out to 3 more regions in Y2 (~$1.5M). They insist Net90 due to central finance cycles.

rachel_revops: Quick math:
```
List:    $720,000
Proposed:$468,000
Discount:35%
Est. Margin at proposed: ~16%
```
If we waive SOW we need offset: service credits, milestone, or case studies. Also Net90 increases AR risk.

mike_finance: Finance can provisionally accept a 35% concession only if these hold: (1) signed PO with budget approval, (2) 20% non-refundable upfront (or escrow), (3) SOW converted to invoice credit spread over first 6 invoices, (4) Net60 max (not Net90) unless VP Sales escalates. Also require explicit no stacking with promos and a 12mo expansion clawback.

sam_reps: Customer claims PO process forces Net90 and no upfront possible. They did offer multi-region reference + executive intro in exchange for onboarding waiver.

ivy_dealdesk: Counter: convert onboarding fee to $60k service credit over first 6 invoices, accept Net75 only if PO + proof of budget hold + signed reference commitment in contract. If they refuse upfront we should insist on stronger clawback.

june_legal: I'll draft an amendment. Need exact SOW line items to convert to credits and a precise definition for "reference" (timing, approvals, public use). Also will add data-residency clause for private deploy and breach notification timelines. Will include escalation language for overdue invoices.

mike_finance: If VP Sales signs off on Net75 I'm OK with the rest. Otherwise we should hold to Net60 + 20% non-refundable. Finance flags cashflow impact; will need AR to monitor.

billing-bot: Template created: /invoices/templates/atlascare_specialterms_v1.docx

sam_reps: I'll push for PO and try to secure the exec intro and reference language. If they cant do upfront, will ask for an award letter or budget-holder email as alternative.

ivy_dealdesk: Marking provisional approved with conditions: PO + signed amendment + reference commitment + SOW line items for credits. If procurement demands absolute waiver and Net90 escalate to SVP Sales. :thumbsup:

mike_finance: Noted. Once docs are in I'll finalize and instruct billing to apply credits. Keep updates here.

june_legal: Drafting now. Send SOW lines and any customer-supplied contract redlines to me. Will aim for EOD.

sam_reps: Sent SOW lines and the customer's procurement note to @june_legal. Will post PO when it lands. Thanks team. :pray:
